title: Batman #33 DC New 52 2014 Zero Year Finale Batman 75th Anniversary Variant Cover
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Batman #33 (September 2014), DC Comics The New 52 - extra-sized finale of "Zero Year": Batman vs. the Riddler. Written by Scott Snyder, art by Greg Capullo, Danny Miki and FCO Plascencia. Batman 75th Anniversary variant cover with the Joker, Catwoman, Harley Quinn, Two-Face, Poison Ivy, the Riddler, Mr. Freeze, Killer Croc and Man-Bat. Direct sales, $4.99 cover price.

Back cover: Splat Color Gel ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
